name: Agent Approval Gate
description: When an agent asks permission: the exact command or diff, a risk tag, and Allow once, Always allow here or Deny. Keyboard first, with a timer that runs only while seen.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the agent asking. Shown in the eyebrow, the denial placeholder and the file-write note.

props.name: request
props.description: What the agent wants to do. Chooses the title, the exact command, the diff, the touch tag and the three facets.

props.name: risk
props.description: How serious the request is in its context. Colours the touch tag (medium uses its own amber, never the accent) and picks the note in its tooltip, which is written for each request.

props.name: showDiff
props.description: Show the diff under the command when the request has one. The command always shows.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Seconds until the request is denied on its own. 0 turns the countdown off. The clock runs only while the card is in view. It pauses while the pointer is over the card, while focus is on a control, while the card is off screen and while the tab is hidden, and it never starts unseen.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the card from outside: pending resets it and clears an earlier answer; approved or denied folds it into the receipt.

props.name: onDecision
props.description: Called once with the answer: once, always (with its scope), deny (with an optional reason) or timeout.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand accent: the primary button, the countdown bar and the selected scope dot. Defaults to ink for the theme (near-white on dark, near-black on light), so the primary action is never amber. Passing either ink ("#f4f4f5" or "#111113") also means ink and follows the theme, which is why the default swatch stays correct in the light theme. The ink that sits on it is picked for contrast. Risk colours are fixed.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the card once it is in view, so Y, A and N answer without a Tab. Shows a quiet outline on the card while the keys are live. The demo turns it on.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the card.

name: Agent Diff Review
description: Review an agent's changes hunk by hunk: Accept or Reject each, rejected hunks fold to a stub, a file rail with +/− counts and a summary that applies what you kept.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the agent that proposed the change. Shown in the eyebrow, beside each hunk note and in the applied receipt.

props.name: title
props.default: "Round money once, in each currency’s own minor unit"
props.description: What the change does, in the agent's words.

props.name: summary
props.description: One or two sentences under the title: why, and what happens on apply.

props.name: proposedAt
props.description: When the agent proposed it, shown in the eyebrow on wider containers.

props.name: runId
props.description: Short run id shown in the eyebrow on wider containers.

props.name: changes
props.description: The change set. Each file has a path, an optional language ("code" or "prose") and hunks with an id, oldStart, newStart, scope, optional note and unified diff lines ({ kind: "ctx" | "add" | "del", text }).

props.name: files
props.description: Show only the first N files of changes. Defaults to all of them; the demo shows 3.

props.name: view
props.description: One column with old and new interleaved, or old and new side by side. The header toggle switches it too. Split needs about 900px; narrower, it reads as unified.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling them sideways. Unwrapped, each hunk (or each side in split) scrolls on its own.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Show old and new line numbers in a gutter.

props.name: defaultDecisions
props.description: Decisions to start from, keyed by hunk id. Anything missing starts pending.

props.name: onDecisionsChange
props.description: Called whenever a hunk is accepted, rejected or reopened, and when a whole file is accepted.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the review from outside: review reopens it with decisions kept, applied locks it into the receipt.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when Apply succeeds and when the person goes back to review.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Runs on Apply accepted. Return a promise to show the applying state; reject it to stay in review.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand accent: the Apply button, accepted marks and the summary strip. Defaults to the theme's ink; either ink ("#f4f4f5" or "#111113") follows the theme. The ink on it is picked for contrast. Additions and removals keep their own green and red.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black review with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when changes is an empty array.

name: Agent Plan
description: A numbered agent plan you reorder and rename before approving, then watch tick through live with timings, a shimmer on the active step and substeps unfolding beneath it.

props.name: title
props.description: The goal the plan serves, in the display face.

props.name: summary
props.default: "Drafted from your request and the current schema. Nothing runs until you approve."
props.description: One line under the title while the plan is a draft.

props.name: steps
props.description: The proposed steps in order. { id, title, duration? (ms of real run time, shown as the estimate), substeps?, outcome?, reason? }. Keep the array stable between renders.

props.name: stepCount
props.description: How many of the steps to propose, from the top (3 to 8).

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled phase. Omit to let the plan manage its own run.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting phase when uncontrolled.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called on approve, pause, resume, retry, edit and when the run finishes or fails.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called with the steps in their final order and wording when the plan is approved.

props.name: editable
props.description: Steps can be dragged, reordered with Alt and the arrow keys, and renamed in draft.

props.name: showTimings
props.description: Estimates in draft, measured times while running and after.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback multiplier for the run's clock. The plan's times stay real: 2 plays the same run in half the wall time.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the approve, resume and retry buttons, and the active step's mark. Everything else is ink and grey.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Agent Run Trace
description: A tracing waterfall for one agent run: nested LLM, tool and retrieval spans on a shared time axis, tokens and cost per span, a marked critical path and a details pane.

props.name: trace
props.description: Your run as flat spans: id, parentId, name, kind (agent, step, llm, tool, retrieval), start and duration in ms, plus optional model, tokensIn, tokensOut, cost, status, statusNote, input and output. Omit it to show the sample support-triage run.

props.name: spans
props.description: How many spans of the sample run to show, 6 to 30, cut in call order. Ignored when trace is set.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Nest rows as the call tree, with collapsible steps and the critical path joined by connectors, or group them into LLM calls, tool calls and retrieval.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Time axis magnification, 1 to 4. Above 1 the lanes scroll sideways under a pinned span column and the selected span is kept in view.

props.name: showCost
props.description: Show cost in the totals, the span column, tooltips and the details pane.

props.name: live
props.description: Replays the run as if it were still in progress: spans arrive as they start, bars grow, totals count and a live edge sweeps the axis. Loops while on screen; a still snapshot with reduced motion.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The span open in the details pane on mount. Defaults to the root span; null starts with the pane closed.

props.name: onSelectSpan
props.description: Called when a span is selected, or with null when the details pane closes.

props.name: runName
props.description: The agent or run name in the header.

props.name: runLabel
props.description: The line beside the name: what the run was for.

props.name: runId
props.description: Shown in mono above the name.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: critical path bars, connectors and the live edge.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the surface, bars and text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root, for width and placement.

name: Bounded Action Review
description: An exact prospective-usage review that separates estimates, actual measurements and each limit before a real host-owned bounded authorization request.
usage:
import { AgentsBudgetGuard } from "@/components/design-for-ai/agents-budget-guard";

<AgentsBudgetGuard action={action} budgets={bounds} status={hostStatus} onAuthorize={requestAuthorization} resetKey={actionRevision} />

props.name: action
props.description: Stable bounded action ID, label/description and optional unavailable reason.

props.name: budgets
props.description: Unique IDs/labels, tokens/calls/cost kind, known whole-unit limit and prospective total estimate, optional actual total, cost currency and supplied decimal unit scale.
props.default: 12000 tokens/6 calls/35 USD cents limits;8400/4/24 estimated

props.name: status
props.description: Authoritative host state. A fulfilled callback alone never marks an action authorized or running.

props.name: statusMessage
props.description: Actual host explanation; blank error receives meaningful fallback.

props.name: onAuthorize
props.description: Real request carrying exact reviewed action/budgets/note. Honor cancellation before host side effects. No execution in this inspector.

props.name: defaultReviewNote
props.description: Initial local note reused for a replacement action/reset; ordinary bound updates retain the draft.
props.default: "Keep the current working route available throughout this bounded review."

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Action/review identity; retires pending work, local confirmation and note.

props.name: title
props.description: Concise bounds heading.

props.name: description
props.description: Explain prospective total, actual and limits.
props.default: "Review the prospective total, the current measurements and the limits before asking the host to authorize this one action."

props.name: theme
props.description: Neutral graphite/paper bounds palettes with semantic errors and actual measurements.

props.name: className
props.description: Outer guard class.

name: Dependency Plan Board
description: An inspectable supplied dependency graph with a complete linear alternative, honest missing/cyclic relationships and authoritative task status.
usage:
import { AgentsDependencyBoard } from "@/components/design-for-ai/agents-dependency-board";

<AgentsDependencyBoard tasks={tasks} value={taskId} onValueChange={inspectTask} resetKey={planId} />

props.name: tasks
props.description: Stable task IDs, title/description, actual queued/running/blocked/complete/error state, raw dependency ID entries and optional owner.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled inspected task ID. Missing identity stays explicit; without observer selection is read-only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial local inspected ID; reset reuses it or first available task.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Synchronous inspection callback. Host rejection keeps the authoritative selected task. No execution.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Supplied plan identity; resets local selection/view/trace.

props.name: title
props.description: Concise relationship heading.

props.name: description
props.description: Explain grounded relationship inspection.
props.default: "Trace the supplied relationships, inspect the blockers and keep the next decision grounded in the actual plan."

props.name: theme
props.description: Neutral dark and paper graph palettes with semantic supplied states.

props.name: className
props.description: Outer board class.

name: Recorded Run Replay
description: A precise replay desk for supplied event snapshots, with an exact clock, bounded native timeline inspection and playback that never executes agent tools.
usage:
import { AgentsRunReplay } from "@/components/design-for-ai/agents-run-replay";

<AgentsRunReplay events={history} time={position} onTimeChange={setInspectionTime} resetKey={runId} />

props.name: events
props.description: Stable unique IDs, nonnegative safe whole-millisecond at values, label/kind/detail and actual full snapshot status/summary/steps. Equal timestamps preserve supplied order.

props.name: initialSnapshot
props.description: Actual supplied state before the first event; missing state remains unavailable.

props.name: time
props.description: Controlled inspection clock in whole milliseconds. Invalid/out-of-range position stays explicit; without observer playback/seek is read-only.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: Initial local inspection position, reused after reset.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Synchronous clock request/observer. Controlled rejection keeps the real clock and stops playback rather than spinning. Honor explicit event inspection at a tied timestamp.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Supplied run identity. Stops playback and clears local time/pinned event/exact draft.

props.name: title
props.description: Concise replay heading.

props.name: description
props.description: Explain supplied history inspection.
props.default: "Inspect a supplied run history, compare the recorded states and keep playback separate from the live workflow."

props.name: theme
props.description: Neutral replay desk palettes with semantic recorded states.

props.name: className
props.description: Outer replay class.

name: Answer Comparison
description: Two supplied answers share an inspectable evidence ledger and an explicit preference, with honest pending, rejection and unavailable-content states.
usage:
import { AiAnswerCompare } from "@/components/design-for-ai/ai-answer-compare";

<AiAnswerCompare request={question} responses={answers} evidence={sources} value={preference} onValueChange={savePreference} resetKey={comparisonId} />

props.name: request
props.description: The shared question. Exact content changes start a new local comparison and retire pending work even when answer IDs are reused.
props.default: "How should we introduce a new navigation pattern without losing the team's current working flow?"

props.name: responses
props.description: Unique answer IDs, labels/descriptions, locally unique plain-text sections with optional evidence IDs, actual ready/loading/error availability and selection permission.

props.name: evidence
props.description: Unique supplied source IDs, label/provenance/excerpt and optional navigable URL. Unknown referenced IDs remain unavailable.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled preference; null means no choice. Explicit authority survives new questions. Without observer selection is read-only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial local preference for a new question/workspace; reused with reset, not the last prior local choice.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (id: string | null, response: AnswerCompareResponse | undefined, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Real preference request. Local state commits only after acknowledgment; controlled authority stays truthful. Honor cancellation before committing host results.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Explicit comparison identity when replacing answers for the same question. Clears local feedback/inspection and retires old requests.

props.name: title
props.description: Concise comparison heading.

props.name: description
props.description: Explain the shared evidence and explicit decision.
props.default: "Read the supplied answers against the same evidence, then choose the one you prefer."

props.name: theme
props.description: Warm violet reading palette.

props.name: className
props.description: Outer comparison class.

controls.label: Shared question
controls.default: How should we introduce a new navigation pattern without losing the team's current working flow?

name: Inline Citations
description: An AI answer with numbered markers on the baseline. Hover one to light the exact span it backs and open a source card; a rail groups duplicate sources.

props.name: question
props.default: "Why do teams cancel at their first renewal?"
props.description: The question the answer responds to, set in serif above the answer.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The question's heading level. Use h3 when the host page already owns the h2; the rail's Sources heading steps down with it.

props.name: answer
props.description: The answer as spans: { text, cite? }. Cited spans are highlighted when their marker is read. A cited span is marked by its last word, so the marker never wraps away from its claim.

props.name: sources
props.description: Retrieved sources in ranked order: { id, title, domain, monogram?, quote, match }. match must appear verbatim inside quote. Sources sharing a domain and title are grouped in the rail and share one marker number.

props.name: maxSources
props.description: How many sources, from the top of the list, may back the answer. Claims cited only to sources beyond it read as plain prose.

props.name: markerStyle
props.description: The marker on the baseline: a bare numeral, a 6px dot, or a boxed numeral chip.

props.name: showRail
props.description: Show the sources rail under the answer. Each source row quotes the sentences it backs and says how many claims that is; clicking a row pins its card on the first claim and moves focus there. The card names the other claims a source backs.

props.name: cardOnHover
props.description: Hovering a marker opens its source card, and moving to another marker glides the card there. The card is placed so it never covers another marker, and the pointer passes through an unpinned card. Off, a click opens and pins it, and the default hint says so. On touch the hint asks for a tap. A tap on another marker moves the card and pins it; a second tap on the pinned marker closes it. Escape closes a pinned card wherever focus is.

props.name: hint
props.description: The line under the answer that says how to read a source. Leave it out for the adaptive wording (hover, click, or tap on touch screens), pass your own copy, or pass false to hide it in a product view.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the highlighter wash behind a cited span, the active marker and the quote mark. A #rrggbb colour.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale surfaces and ink. The accent stays the same in both themes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Context Budget
description: An inspectable context planner with exact supplied source counts, reversible inclusion and a reserved answer budget that exposes over-limit choices.
usage:
import { AiContextBudget } from "@/components/design-for-ai/ai-context-budget";

<AiContextBudget sources={context} budget={16000} reservedTokens={4000} value={includedIds} onValueChange={setIncludedIds} resetKey={workspaceId} />

props.name: sources
props.description: Unique source IDs, label/kind/description, externally counted complete-source tokens (null means unknown), optional supplied content/excerpt, required and disabled selection states.
props.default: 5 original offline source records and excerpts

props.name: budget
props.description: Nonnegative safe-integer token capacity. Invalid values are unavailable, not guessed.

props.name: reservedTokens
props.description: Nonnegative safe-integer answer reservation. Counts with selected sources and may itself exceed capacity.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled source inclusion IDs. Required sources always count; without observer inclusion is read-only. Inspection stays available.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled inclusion IDs; changes only apply with resetKey.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Synchronous full inclusion request, normalized to available records and required sources. No execution or fetching.

props.name: onInspect
props.description: Optional observer of local source inspection, independent of inclusion.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Workspace identity; resets local selection/inspection and preview scroll while preserving controlled authority.

props.name: title
props.description: Concise planner heading.

props.name: description
props.description: Explain the source review task.
props.default: "Inspect each source. Include the parts that help, and leave room for the answer."

props.name: theme
props.description: Warm dark or pale olive palette.

props.name: className
props.description: Outer planner class.

name: Image Generation
description: Four studies from one prompt, drawn in code. Each develops out of grain. Vary redraws the one you picked, and Upscale enlarges it.

props.name: prompt
props.default: "North light through a paper screen, one branch."
props.description: The brief, set in serif above the studies.

props.name: seed
props.description: Base seed. The studies use this value, then the next three. Changing it redraws all four. Read again whenever it changes.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled frame. Grid is the four studies. Upscaled enlarges the selected one and keeps the others as a strip. Omit it and the desk owns the state.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when Upscale or All four changes the frame.

props.name: onVary
props.description: Called with the study index and its new seed when Vary redraws it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, used on Upscale. A #rrggbb colour. Near-white or near-black values use the theme’s ink. The selected study is ringed in the print’s ink, and the sunlight in the pictures stays warm.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surface with white ink, or the white inverse. The prints keep their paper.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

controls.label: Prompt
controls.default: North light through a paper screen, one branch.

name: MCP Elicitation
description: A tool call that pauses the thread and asks for the fields it cannot guess. A bad time is refused, a free one books, and the assistant continues.

props.name: userName
props.description: Who asked for the tool to run. Shown above their message.

props.name: request
props.default: "Hold Studio B for the design review on Thursday."
props.description: The message above the form.

props.name: agent
props.description: The assistant that paused for the tool.

props.name: pause
props.default: "calendar.hold stopped. It needs the fields it can’t guess."
props.description: The line under the request, before the form.

props.name: tool
props.description: Tool that asked for the fields. Shown in mono in the card header.

props.name: room
props.description: Room the tool is trying to hold. Used in the people line, the conflict and the receipt.

props.name: slots
props.description: Choices for when: { id, label, detail, available }. One of them is unavailable. detail is a short availability note such as “Held until 3”.

props.name: defaultSlot
props.description: Slot id selected before anyone touches the form. Read on mount. The default is the unavailable slot, so the conflict can be shown.

props.name: lengths
props.description: Lengths in minutes, shown as a segmented control.

props.name: defaultLength
props.description: Length selected before anyone touches the form. Read on mount.

props.name: guests
props.description: How many people. Pass it to control the count. Omit it and the stepper owns it, from 1 to 12.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Seats in the room. More guests than this blocks Continue and names the limit.

props.name: conflict
props.default: "Studio B is held by Finance until 3. 4:30 is open."
props.description: Why the unavailable slot is refused. Shown after Continue, not before.

props.name: confirmation
props.description: The line after a valid submit. {when}, {length}, {room} and {guests} are filled in.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled state. Asking shows the form. Booked replaces it with the receipt and the assistant’s next line. Omit it and the thread owns the state.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when a valid Continue books the room.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (value: { slotId: string; length: number; guests: number }) => void
props.description: Called with the accepted fields when the run resumes. A refused slot does not call it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the selection dot, the length marker’s ink, and Continue. A #rrggbb colour. Near-white or near-black values use the theme’s ink so the button stays readable. Ink on the button is chosen for contrast.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surface with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Model Picker
description: A model select that helps you choose: aligned speed, price and context bars, capability tags, typeahead, and a compare that diffs any model against the current one.

props.name: catalog
props.default: Eight fictional models from three labs
props.description: Every model on offer: id, name, a one-line note, tokensPerSecond, usdPerMillion (blended), contextTokens and capabilities ("vision", "tools", "long-context").

props.name: models
props.description: How many models from the catalogue to show, 3 to 8. Bars share one scale across what is visible.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled model id. Leave out to let the picker keep its own.

props.name: defaultValue
props.default: "meridian-pro" in the demo, otherwise the first model
props.description: Model id on first render when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs when a model is chosen by pointer or keyboard.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label above the trigger, and the accessible name of the list.

props.name: layout
props.description: List: rows with the bars aligned in columns under a header. Grid: two columns of cards, each with its own labelled bars.

props.name: showCost
props.description: Shows the price column, its bars, its delta and the price on the trigger.

props.name: showCompare
props.description: Marks the current model on every bar and diffs the highlighted model against it, in the bars and in words. Off, the footer shows a count and a typeahead hint.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens the panel on first render without moving focus into it. The demo opens it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the check, the stretch of a bar where the highlighted model beats the current one, and the winning deltas. Darkened toward the ink on light.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black trigger and panel with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root. The panel opens below the trigger, so leave room under it.

name: Search Answer
description: An AI search answer page set like an editorial: a sources strip that loads first, the answer streaming with inline markers, follow-ups that fill the query box.

props.name: query
props.default: "Why does sourdough rise so slowly in winter?"
props.description: The question that was asked, set as the page's serif headline. A new query cross-fades the headline, folds the source list and drops any pinned source.

props.name: status
props.description: Searching fills the sources strip, with shimmering slots for sources still to come. Answering streams the answer under it with a caret. Done adds the follow-ups and the time taken.

props.name: sources
props.description: Retrieved sources in ranked order: { id, title, domain, snippet, monogram?, date?, href? }. Pass them as they arrive; each lands in the strip with a short rise. With href, tiles and rows are links that open in a new tab.

props.name: answer
props.description: The answer so far, as the model writes it. Paragraphs are split by a blank line and [n] cites the nth source. The first paragraph is set as the lede. New words settle in as they arrive, and a marker still arriving ('[1') is held back until it closes.

props.name: followUps
props.description: Questions to ask next. They slide in once the answer is done; a click types one into the query box and focuses it, so the reader can edit it before asking.

props.name: showFollowUps
props.description: Show the follow-ups section above the query box.

props.name: maxSources
props.description: How many sources, from the top of the list, are shown and may be cited. Markers pointing past it are dropped, so the answer only ever cites what the strip shows. The strip shows four tiles: all four sources, or three and a +N tile that opens the full list.

props.name: density
props.description: Reading sets a 16.5px answer with an 18.5px lede and two-line source titles; compact is 14.5px with one-line titles, for a side panel.

props.name: elapsedMs
props.description: How long the search took, shown in the status line once done (8 sources · 3.4 s).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The headline's level. The Sources and Ask next headings step down one level from it.

props.name: onAsk
props.description: Called with the trimmed text when the query box is submitted (Enter, or the Ask button). Shift+Enter adds a line. The box clears itself.

props.name: onSourceOpen
props.description: Called when a source tile or list row is clicked. A click also pins that source's spotlight; a second click or Escape releases it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label for the query box.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, a #rrggbb colour: the live dot while searching, the spotlight wash behind the sentences a source backs, lit markers and the Ask button once there is text.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale surfaces and ink. The accent stays the same in both.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

props.name: ask
props.description: Demo only. Default export only, not part of the component API. Runs one of the four scripted questions: sources load, then the answer streams.

props.name: speed
props.description: Demo only. Default export only, not part of the component API. Stream pace: 2 runs twice as fast. Changing it replays the current search at the new pace.

name: Side Panel
description: An editor docked beside a draft. Mark a sentence to pull it in as a chip, then apply the rewrite so the line highlights, with one undo.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the editor in the margin. The monogram is the first letter.

props.name: role
props.description: Role under the name.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono path above the draft. Truncates rather than wrapping.

props.name: draftMark
props.description: Quiet mark at the right of the path, such as a draft number.

props.name: heading
props.description: The question the draft answers, set in serif.

props.name: lede

props.name: chords

props.name: accent
